title: The /themes page shows Honey and Mindless, eleven kits, each drawn in its own accents

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-19: "Make Sure Mindless and Honey have their full theme kit with all designs. List Honey in the themes, so we have 10."

detail: The /themes showcase was a port of the nine-kit design, so the two newest offered themes had no section. Honey and Mindless now have their own sections after Nocturne: catalogue data (accents, fonts, readiness, kit counts), a skin and decoration drawn in each theme's own system (Honey's limewash, rays and gilt orb; Mindless's warm ink and one paint), and real renders of the website, Spotlight and welcome email for every accent (Honey's five profile accents, Mindless's three paints) under public/themes-index/s/themes/<dir>/shots, made by scripts/render/theme-showcase-shots.mjs. Use and See the full kit link to the builder and to /themes/free-human and /themes/mindless. The gallery count pins move from nine to eleven on the owner's words. Honey's website and Spotlight keep the madder solid button on every accent by the theme's design (FREE_HUMAN_SOLID); the accent reaches the email and the Space page.
